title: Fan-in prompts and mailbox wakes for a root session were held for about 1.5–2 h and released only after the host restart
outcome: A completed delegation wait and a mailbox wake reach their idle parent session within seconds; a prompt that cannot be dispatched says why on the session and to the sender, rather than waiting silently until a restart.
acceptance: Fan-in prompts and mailbox wakes for a root session were held for about 1.5–2 h and released only after the host restart is done
